legend.D: Current-course supported workflow (may be explicitly scoped to demonstrated subtype).
legend.L: Limited branch, modelling transfer or enrichment; may not be auto-eligible.
legend.-: No recommended launch curriculum mapping, not a ban on browsing standalone.

entries.title: Numerical entry, notation and rounding
entries.representativeMethod: Enter parentheses, signed values and scientific notation; round the final result.
entries.limits: Shared foundational calculator skill.

entries.title: Angle modes and inverse trigonometry
entries.representativeMethod: Set degree/radian mode and use inverse trig with correct angular output.
entries.limits: AI SL triangle work uses degrees; radians are explicitly AI AHL3.7.

entries.title: Combinations and factorials
entries.representativeMethod: Enter nCr and factorial; distinguish different counting operands.
entries.limits: AA SL1.9 nCr; AA HL1.10 broader counting; AI use only as a binomial-probability aid, not a combinatorics course claim.

entries.title: Sequences, sigma and first threshold
entries.representativeMethod: Use explicit sequence terms and finite sums; check the first integer term meeting a threshold.
entries.limits: Shared SL1.2–1.3; not a full recurrence/spreadsheet coach.

entries.title: Financial mathematics and TVM
entries.representativeMethod: Finance Solver with PMT=0; enter signed PV, annual rate and compounding to solve lump-sum FV.
entries.limits: Shared compound growth SL1.4; recurring payments, annuities and amortization AI SL1.7 not implemented.

entries.title: Numerical solve: equations with multiple roots
entries.representativeMethod: nSolve on deliberately separated brackets; confirm number/domain of relevant roots.
entries.limits: Shared numerical equation workflow; it does not enumerate all solutions automatically.

entries.title: Simultaneous equations and unknown parameters
entries.representativeMethod: Use the native simultaneous-equation tool with numerical coefficients and read an ordered solution.
entries.limits: For AA SL use only as applied equation solving/checking; formal three-variable systems are AA AHL1.16.

entries.title: Graph setup, zoom and viewing window
entries.representativeMethod: Select an informative viewing window and zoom without changing the mathematical domain.
entries.limits: Shared graph prerequisite; no exact proof inferred from screen.

entries.title: Trace, tables and function values
entries.representativeMethod: Trace and use a function table to evaluate formulae and inspect features.
entries.limits: Shared graph prerequisite; tracing alone does not prove a global result.

entries.title: Zeros and intercepts
entries.representativeMethod: Select and bracket a zero or read a graph intercept.
entries.limits: Only an original compatible input and workflow; discontinuity/tangency checks remain needed.

entries.title: Intersections of two functions
entries.representativeMethod: Enter two curves, select Intersection and bracket the intended crossing.
entries.limits: Shared graphical solve; a canvas crossing is not an exact solution.

entries.title: Local and global maxima and minima
entries.representativeMethod: Bracket a minimum; separate maximum companion checks endpoints against an interior extremum.
entries.limits: AA SL5.8 and AI SL5.6–5.7; 1 skill ID with 2 routes, not 2 skills.

entries.title: Graphical inequalities and exclusions
entries.representativeMethod: Find and interpret where one graph lies above/below another; respect exclusions.
entries.limits: AI SL as inequality/threshold interpretation on a given model; not a general symbolic inequality engine.

entries.title: All trigonometric solutions in an interval
entries.representativeMethod: Use angle setup and bracket multiple trig intersections within a finite interval; account for endpoints.
entries.limits: AA SL3.8; AI AHL3.8 explicitly; AI SL only contextual sinusoid/finite evaluation, not a standalone exhaustive-equation mandate.

entries.title: Piecewise, restricted and transformed graphs
entries.representativeMethod: Enter restricted/piecewise graph expressions and check branch endpoints and values.
entries.limits: AI AHL2.8–2.9; AI SL restricted-domain/model practice only and not full transformation or arbitrary piecewise coverage.

entries.title: Finding a model threshold
entries.representativeMethod: Find a continuous threshold crossing and decide first whole period correctly.
entries.limits: Not interchangeable with CT06 when domain or strict/inclusive integer threshold matters.

entries.title: 2D/3D lengths, angles and bearings
entries.representativeMethod: Use arithmetic, trigonometry and degree settings for selected 2D/3D lengths, angles and bearings.
entries.limits: Shared SL3.1–3.3; no geometric drawing engine.

entries.title: Voronoi sites and nearest neighbours
entries.representativeMethod: Compare squared Euclidean distances to decide a nearest site; distinguish equal-distance ties.
entries.limits: AI SL3.6; not a calculator-generated Voronoi graph or full construction/area workflow.

entries.title: Vector arithmetic and angles
entries.representativeMethod: Enter/interpret vector operations and compute an angle by dot product / magnitudes.
entries.limits: AA HL Topic 3 and AI HL AHL3.11–3.13; no line/plane system proof, vector-locus or general intersection coach.

entries.title: Complex numbers: rectangular and polar
entries.representativeMethod: Set complex display; enter numeric a+bi, modulus and argument; switch rectangular/polar.
entries.limits: AA and AI AHL1.12–1.13; no general roots/de Moivre or exact symbolic proof.

entries.title: Matrices: entry, determinant and inverse
entries.representativeMethod: Create/store a numerical matrix and obtain determinant or inverse with domain checks.
entries.limits: AI AHL1.14; does not teach every possible operation or large singular system.

entries.title: Matrix transformations of coordinates
entries.representativeMethod: Multiply 2×2 transformation by a 2×1 position vector and interpret the output.
entries.limits: AI AHL3.9; single linear transform, not full affine translation/composition/determinant-area workflow.

entries.title: Solve linear systems using matrices
entries.representativeMethod: Set up numerical matrix coefficients/constants and solve the compatible system.
entries.limits: AI AHL1.14; AA HL numerical system solving uses CT07, not matrix syllabus credit.

entries.title: Transition matrices and Markov chains
entries.representativeMethod: Enter a transition matrix; use matrix powers and start-state orientation.
entries.limits: AI AHL4.19; no automatic chain diagnosis or all absorbing/irregular cases.

entries.title: Eigenvalues and long-run behaviour
entries.representativeMethod: 2×2 distinct-real eigenvalue/long-run calculation using the supported workflow.
entries.limits: AI AHL1.15; no complex/repeated-eigenvalue or unlimited diagonalization.

entries.title: Adjacency matrices and walks
entries.representativeMethod: Raise a small adjacency matrix to the required power and read the correct walk count.
entries.limits: AI AHL3.15; walks are not simple paths; not general graph algorithms.

entries.title: Network algorithms: shortest routes
entries.representativeMethod: Compare numerical simple routes and complete one symmetric least-distance entry, with ties.
entries.limits: AI AHL3.16 assist only; no Prim, Kruskal, Chinese postman, or nearest-neighbour/deleted-vertex TSP.

entries.title: Create lists and frequency tables
entries.representativeMethod: Name lists and prepare aligned values/frequencies for subsequent tools.
entries.limits: Shared descriptive-statistics prerequisite.

entries.title: One-variable statistics and standard deviation
entries.representativeMethod: Run one-variable stats and distinguish population sigma from sample SD.
entries.limits: Shared SL4.3; choose the right frequency input and result label.

entries.title: Box plots, outliers and histograms
entries.representativeMethod: Build a boxplot and interpret quartiles/fences/outliers.
entries.limits: No histogram or ogive implemented, despite catalogue title.

entries.title: Pearson correlation and linear regression
entries.representativeMethod: Run Pearson r and fit/read a linear regression using matched pairs and correct orientation.
entries.limits: Shared SL4.4; no reverse-fit shortcut or significance test for population rho.

entries.title: Quadratic and other nonlinear regression
entries.representativeMethod: Use QuadReg with paired input; read a,b,c, R² and residuals; plot/follow a saved formula.
entries.limits: AI AHL4.13 nonlinear regression and R²/residuals. AI SL2.5–2.6 model use transfers; performing QuadReg is enrichment only and omitted from its filtered catalogue.

entries.title: Exponential regression and growth factors
entries.representativeMethod: Run ExpReg and interpret a,b in a·b^x; positive responses and transformed-fit caveat.
entries.limits: AI AHL4.13 nonlinear regression; transformed-fit interpretation relates to AHL2.10. AI SL2.5–2.6 model use transfers; performing ExpReg is enrichment only and omitted from its filtered catalogue.

entries.title: Linearizing data with logarithms
entries.representativeMethod: Create ln(y) list and fit a line against x; back-transform intercept and slope.
entries.limits: AI AHL2.10, semi-log only; the log–log power branch is described, not simulated.

entries.title: Spearman rank correlation
entries.representativeMethod: Assign midranks for ties then use Pearson on rank lists, not raw data.
entries.limits: AI SL4.10; assisted because ranking is not faked as a native Spearman wizard.

entries.title: Discrete random variables and expectation
entries.representativeMethod: Compute an expected value with weighted outcomes and guard probability totals.
entries.limits: Shared SL4.7 family; AI HL linear-combination variance is not covered end-to-end.

entries.title: Binomial: exact probability
entries.representativeMethod: Enter binomial parameters and a single exact X outcome in Binomial Pdf.
entries.limits: Shared binomial distribution; not a significance interpretation.

entries.title: Binomial: cumulative and complements
entries.representativeMethod: Use Binomial Cdf with inclusive limits; translate strict events and complements correctly.
entries.limits: Shared binomial probability; raw answer alone is not exam working.

entries.title: Normal: interval and tail probabilities
entries.representativeMethod: Use Normal Cdf for intervals, lower tails and upper tails with mean and SD.
entries.limits: Shared normal probability.

entries.title: Inverse normal: percentiles and cutoffs
entries.representativeMethod: Use inverse normal to convert area into a percentile/cutoff with parameters known.
entries.limits: Shared normal quantile; choose lower-tail cumulative area, not the literal upper-tail probability.

entries.title: Solve an unknown normal parameter
entries.representativeMethod: Find an unknown mean or SD from a known cutoff/probability using inverse normal and algebra.
entries.limits: AA SL4.12 direct; AI SL4.9 inverse tasks specify mean and SD are given and not standardized z. Enrichment/compatible advanced case only; no generic AI auto-link.

entries.title: Poisson: exact and cumulative probabilities
entries.representativeMethod: Use Poisson Pdf/Cdf with the rate for a given interval and discrete inclusivity.
entries.limits: AI AHL4.17; Poisson hypothesis test/critical region is distinct AI AHL4.18, not a tested route here.

entries.title: Sampling means and the central limit theorem
entries.representativeMethod: Select sampling-mean distribution, use sigma/sqrt(n), enter finite or tail Normal Cdf.
entries.limits: AI AHL4.15; not general sums/differences of independent non-identically distributed normal variables.

entries.title: Random simulation and repeated trials
entries.representativeMethod: Simulate repeated random trials, distinguish observed proportion and theoretical probability.
entries.limits: AI probability modelling context; not a substitute for exact methods or every simulation.

entries.title: One-sample z-test: known population SD
entries.representativeMethod: Run one-sample mean z-test with known population SD, choose alternative and interpret p.
entries.limits: AI AHL4.18, not an unknown-SD t-test or generic two-sample z workflow.

entries.title: One-sample and two-sample t-tests
entries.representativeMethod: Use a pooled independent two-sample t-test or one-sample t-test via summary statistics.
entries.limits: AI SL4.11 covers the pooled independent branch only; one-sample/matched differences AI AHL4.18. In AI SL link only pooled two-sample.

entries.title: Chi-square test of independence
entries.representativeMethod: Enter contingency table, run chi-square independence and interpret p and df.
entries.limits: AI SL4.11; no automatic validity for sparse tables and exam bounds still apply.

entries.title: Chi-square goodness-of-fit
entries.representativeMethod: Enter observed/expected lists, df, and run chi-square goodness-of-fit.
entries.limits: AI SL4.11 uses prescribed df; check expected frequencies and any fitted-parameter constraints for HL.

entries.title: Confidence intervals: z and t
entries.representativeMethod: Pick z/t interval from known/unknown population SD and interpret interval endpoints.
entries.limits: AI AHL4.16 one normal population mean; not a proportion interval.

entries.title: Exact binomial hypothesis test
entries.representativeMethod: Run a one-tailed exact binomial test through the inclusive binomial tail and decide.
entries.limits: AI AHL4.18; not a full critical-region/Type-II-power workflow.

entries.title: Numerical derivative and tangent line
entries.representativeMethod: Find a numerical derivative at a point and build/read a tangent equation.
entries.limits: Shared SL5.4; not symbolic differentiation, normal-line construction or second derivative.

entries.title: Stationary points via numerical derivative
entries.representativeMethod: Graph f′, isolate zero and classify with sign on either side; repeated-root safeguard.
entries.limits: AA SL5.7–5.8 and AI SL5.6: compatible polynomials; AI SL classification only required scope, not formal non-stationary inflection/second-derivative treatment.

entries.title: Kinematics: displacement versus total distance
entries.representativeMethod: Find velocity sign-change points, integrate signed pieces, compare displacement/total distance.
entries.limits: AA SL5.9 and AI AHL5.13. AI SL5.7 explicitly excludes exam kinematics.

entries.title: Numerical definite integral and signed area
entries.representativeMethod: Use Graphs Integral and distinguish signed result from geometric area.
entries.limits: AA SL5.5/5.11–5.12; AI SL5.5 only compatible numerical integral/positive area; AI AHL5.12 negative integrals direct.

entries.title: Area between two curves
entries.representativeMethod: Split where upper curve changes, use Bounded Area on each region and add magnitudes.
entries.limits: AA SL5.12; for AI HL transfer of integral setup only, not explicit AHL5.12 two-curve syllabus coverage; no AI SL auto-link.

entries.title: Trapezoidal rule and approximation
entries.representativeMethod: Compute equal-step trapezoid estimate and distinguish an estimate from exact area.
entries.limits: AI SL5.8 explicitly equal-width; not AA launch exam scope.

entries.title: Volumes of revolution
entries.representativeMethod: Set up and numerically evaluate x-axis disk/washer volume.
entries.limits: AA AHL5.17 and AI AHL5.12 include both axes, but y-axis is not implemented.

entries.title: Euler method for a first-order ODE
entries.representativeMethod: Carry out forward-Euler updates manually on calculator using prior row values.
entries.limits: AI AHL5.16; assisted arithmetic, not native differential-equation solver or arbitrary nonlinear problem support.

entries.title: Coupled ODEs, slopes and phase paths
entries.representativeMethod: Update both state components from the same old state and interpret plotted phase samples.
entries.limits: AI HL extension workflow for AHL5.16/5.18 related case; no generic nonlinear/coupled solver or native phase portrait.
